comment: DPI-H components (right set): I would agree that ultimately one would aim to arrive at this set of components. However, as stated earlier, even such higher-level facilities are likely to go through generations and revisions, forced by usage pressures. Building such facilities green fields seems to entail significant risk. It is probably better to elevate well-working local implementations to a national level, rather that starting with the assumption that a component 'be built and they will come'.
